fact: The National Council for Artificial Intelligence, chaired by the communications and IT minister, formally adopted Egypt's Open Data Policy, drafted by MCIT, as a reference document for all government entities; it entered into force in August 2025 as a transitional framework pending a data governance law.

Al-Ahram Gate reports the minister of communications and information technology, Amr Talaat, listing the launch of the open data policy among the supportive policies and legislation Egypt has adopted for digital transformation; the article gives no launch date, so the publication date is used.
